clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan, Techbot's Memory Core holds the data Tinkmaster Overspark needs to study its corrupted behavior.

Before Gnomeregan fell, Techbot aided Tinkmaster Overspark and his fellow inventors with a wealth of devices and knowledge. During the city's fall, an errant electrical discharge jolted the automaton and inverted its positronic brain into a hostile negatronic state. Now Techbot wanders Gnomeregan's tainted halls, attacking anyone in sight. Overspark hopes the memory core will help him understand the malfunction and restore his creation to its senses.
